admission_rule: stage 0: check_strict_kernel.inertness_violation(meaning) is None; stages 1-3: exactly one hypothesis makes the extracted decider agree (_strict_s0.agrees) with the oracle on every probe of stages 1 and 2 (with the command's TeX groups measured by stage G); stage 3b: every frame-kind pair the model stacks with the command agrees at the group bound and is outside the fragment one group past it (A-CAP-*); stage 4: every interleaving document of the admitted set agrees
